title: Bell Toggles Open
description: The notification bell in the nav is a simple toggle — click to open the dropdown, click again to close it — and its aria-expanded state should always tell the truth about which state it's in.
successCondition: On any page while logged in, the "Notifications" button in the top nav has aria-expanded="false" and no dropdown region visible by default; clicking it sets aria-expanded="true" and reveals a role="region" aria-label="Notifications" panel; clicking the button again returns aria-expanded to "false" and hides the panel.
hints: The button lives in the top-right of the header, rendered by NotificationBell.tsx inside NavShell — present on every authenticated page.
Check the aria-expanded attribute value directly rather than just visual presence, since it's what assistive tech relies on.
